fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2025-12-23, around 16:00, a loan agent collected Rs. 12,00,000 from Meena Murugan for approving a personal loan and then stopped answering calls, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-12-24. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Mathan Velan, using the number 9000000147. A further person, Madhan Palanisamy, a driver, using the number 9000000295, is stated to be associated with the incident. Nithin Velan (9000000004) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant mentioned a witness statement, mobile phone records and social media screenshots. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00177, as the mobile number 9000000147 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Witness statement; Mobile phone record; Social media screenshot
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly claimed a guaranteed approval and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: loan fraud, processing fee, suspect, mobile number, afternoon, phone records, residential colony, witness statement
